description: Why an assembled prompt is not valid. The prompt library maps the kind to its own localized message, so the parser (which owns no localization) can report the fact without owning the wording.

members.name: MissingRequired
members.description: A required variable has neither a value nor a default, so its placeholder could not be replaced.

members.name: NotAnOption
members.description: A Select variable was given a value that is not one of its Options. The value is still substituted; the host is told it is not an offered option.
